checks.exercise: Downward-facing dog supported hold with small controlled shoulder movement
checks.setup: 손바닥을 어깨너비로, 발을 골반너비로 바닥에 댄다. 엉덩이를 뒤쪽 위로 들어 몸을 거꾸로 된 V자 모양으로 만든다.
checks.hands: Both palms fixed with forward fingers; elbow angles 158–164 degrees
checks.feet: Both feet fixed on floor; knees softly extended at 163 degrees
checks.movement: 손으로 바닥을 밀며 등을 길게 유지한다. 무릎과 팔꿈치는 잠그지 않고 뒤꿈치를 바닥 쪽으로 내리며 편하게 호흡한다.

limitations: Procedural pose demonstration, not captured human motion.
Shows supported hold and small weight adjustment, not full plank-to-dog transition.
Clothing is a skinned surface without fabric simulation.
Sampled floor clearances are not exhaustive collision certification.
